integrity: The underlying cubic field, invariant lines, and Darboux first integral are established prior work. The claimed result is the sharp finite-area and affine-asymptote geometry plus uniform critical windows.
scientific_limitations: Only the positive-parameter escaping side of the stated integrable cubic field is proved; no perturbation robustness, absolute publication priority or independent certification is claimed. The 2017 and 2023 general Darboux-related articles have not been fully inspected.
title: Two geometric criticalities of cubic Darboux escape trajectories
